subject: Request: entitlement snapshot + SAML assertion samples for SOC2 intake
messages:
From: Jamie Lowe <jamie.lowe@healthnova.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.example.com
Cc: audrey.chen@healthnova.com
Date: Tue, 05 Oct 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Entitlement snapshot + SAML assertion samples for SOC2 intake

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the walkthrough this morning. As we prepare HealthNova's SOC2 intake, our security team needs a few artifacts so we can complete the SIG and CAIQ cross-checks:

1) A role/entitlement snapshot showing current assignments for the last 90 days (service accounts + human users).
2) Representative SAML response/assertion samples showing NameID, attribute mappings, and audience/recipient values.
3) A small SCIM delta (create/update/delete) example and the timestamp format you use for deltas.

Can you send these, or point me to a secure share where we can pull them? Goal is to import into our evidence tracker by end of week.

If anything is sensitive, we can accept redacted samples (just keep the schema/attributes intact).

Best,
Jamie
Head of InfoSec, HealthNova

---
Note: we typically prefer ZIPs delivered to our SFTP or a Drive link with restricted access.
From: marissa.cole@redwood.example.com
To: Jamie Lowe <jamie.lowe@healthnova.com>
Cc: grace.oconnor@redwood.example.com, rishi.malhotra@redwood.example.com
Date: Tue, 05 Oct 2027 10:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Entitlement snapshot + SAML assertion samples for SOC2 intake

Thanks Jamie — looping in Grace (IAM audits) and Rishi (customer security ops). We can provide the items you listed. Quick notes before we pull files:

- Entitlement snapshot: we can export an "entitlement snapshot" with columns (principal id, principal type, role, resource, assignment_date, last_activity). We will include a separate sheet for service accounts and mark transient/jit roles.
- SAML samples: we'll provide two anonymized SAML responses (one for a web app, one for an API gateway) with real attribute names but redacted values.
- SCIM delta: we'll attach a CSV showing a sample create, replace, and remove event; include the change token and timestamp.

We'll upload to a limited-access Drive folder and send a link. If HealthNova needs the files via SFTP, tell us the preferred endpoint and a PGP key for encryption.

Target: deliver by EOD Wednesday (2027-10-06).

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Manager, Security & Compliance Intake
Redwood Inference
From: grace.oconnor@redwood.example.com
To: marissa.cole@redwood.example.com, Jamie Lowe <jamie.lowe@healthnova.com>
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwood.example.com
Date: Tue, 05 Oct 2027 13:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Entitlement snapshot + SAML assertion samples for SOC2 intake

Hi Jamie / Marissa — thanks for the heads up. A few clarifications from the audit side:

- For the snapshot timeframe, HealthNova asked for "last 90 days"; we will include snapshot_date and an origin column (SCIM / console / provisioning API) so auditors can trace changes.
- For RBAC: do you want owners mapped to each role in the sheet (recommended) or a separate ownership roster? We can provide owners inline to reduce back-and-forth.
- Regarding SAML attributes: we'll leave email and uid redacted, but include the full attribute names and an attribute -> internal-claim mapping column.

I'm attaching a quick checklist and the three files in redacted form. If any item needs reformatting for HealthNova's tooling, highlight it and we will adapt.

Grace O'Connor
Principal, IAM Controls
Redwood Inference

Attachment stubs: saml_assertion_samples.txt, scim_delta_sample.csv, rbac_entitlement_snapshot_20271005.xlsx
From: marissa.cole@redwood.example.com
To: Jamie Lowe <jamie.lowe@healthnova.com>, audrey.chen@healthnova.com
Cc: grace.oconnor@redwood.example.com, rishi.malhotra@redwood.example.com
Date: Wed, 06 Oct 2027 08:56:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Entitlement snapshot + SAML assertion samples for SOC2 intake

Jamie / Audrey — files are uploaded to a restricted Drive link and shared with both HealthNova addresses. Summary of what we provided:

- rbac_entitlement_snapshot_20271005.xlsx (service accounts tab, human users tab, owner column, origin column, assignment timestamps).
- saml_assertion_samples.txt (two anonymized responses; each includes assertion ID, issuer, audience, recipient, subject confirmation, and attribute list).
- scim_delta_sample.csv (3 rows: create, replace, delete; includes changeToken and iso8601 timestamps).

Link: https://drive.redwood.example.com/Shared/HealthNova/SSO-Evidence-2027-10-05 (access granted to jamie.lowe@healthnova.com and audrey.chen@healthnova.com for 30 days)

Notes / caveats:
- We removed exact UPNs and user emails from the samples; attribute names and formats are unchanged.
- We used ISO-8601 timestamps in UTC for SCIM deltas.
- If auditors require raw logs (SAML token logs or SCIM server logs) we will coordinate a packaged delivery through our security operations team; that requires a short NDA amendment.

Let me know if you want the RBAC snapshot filtered by environment (prod vs. staging) or if a separate owners roster is preferred.

Thanks,
Marissa
From: Jamie Lowe <jamie.lowe@healthnova.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.example.com
Cc: audrey.chen@healthnova.com, grace.oconnor@redwood.example.com, rishi.malhotra@redwood.example.com
Date: Wed, 06 Oct 2027 14:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Entitlement snapshot + SAML assertion samples for SOC2 intake

Marissa / team — received and reviewed the samples. They look good and the schema maps cleanly into our SIG intake. A couple of small asks before we close this ticket:

- Could you supply one short example of how you identify just-in-time (JIT) elevated roles in the snapshot (we saw the transient flag, but need an example row and a note on TTL semantics).
- For the SAML responses: include a short text note that indicates the typical assertion lifetime and how you rotate SAML signing keys (KMS/HSM cadence or rotation window).

If you can drop those two items into the same Drive folder, we'll mark this as resolved on our side. Appreciate the fast turnaround.

Best,
Jamie
From: marissa.cole@redwood.example.com
To: Jamie Lowe <jamie.lowe@healthnova.com>
Cc: grace.oconnor@redwood.example.com, rishi.malhotra@redwood.example.com
Date: Wed, 06 Oct 2027 15:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Entitlement snapshot + SAML assertion samples for SOC2 intake

Thanks — we'll add a sample JIT row and a short note on assertion lifetime and signing-key rotation policy to the Drive folder within the hour.

Marissa
